--- title: "Page Dividers" filters: - whitphx/stlite --- The divider is a simple function that puts a horizontal line across the width of the page. This can make it easier to indicate different sections of the page that should be looked at together. ::: {#49c71143 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import streamlit as st st.title("This is a title") st.write("Here's a first line of text") st.divider() st.write("Here's some more text") st.divider() st.write("Here's the final text") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ::: {.ansi-escaped-output} ```{=html}
